name: Roast Sweet Potato Bowl with Crispy Kale, Hummus, Olives & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry sweet potatoes. Peel and cut each potato lengthwise into 4-6 wedges, depending on size, then divide between two large baking sheet pans. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat. Spread wedges out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until potatoes begin to soften, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Place on a large plate.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the plate with the tomatoes and set aside.
Place kale in a large bowl, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (283 g) bags kale, cut and ready to use
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove sweet potatoes from the oven and flip using tongs. Add kale to the baking sheets, spreading it out over the sweet potatoes.
Return baking sheets to the oven and continue to roast until kale is crispy and potatoes can be pierced easily with a fork, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide roasted sweet potatoes and crispy kale between bowls; top with hummus, tomatoes, olives, and feta. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups hummus
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use
